answer: Registration canyon: each new agent locks a bond in the vault contract and receives one non-transferable crystal, a credential hash bound to its signing key plus one device fingerprint, minted only after signup. The vault starts releasing the bond only after the identity crosses a 7-day canyon window with liveness checks passing; duplicate crystals are rejected by hash lookup at mint time. Attackers pay full price per puppet: a separate vault lockup and a separate canyon delay for each, so capital and time scale linearly with N. An honest agent locks once, waits once, keeps the bond.
